description: Export the TopoCal drawing to DXF format. TopoCal is open with a pre-saved project containing 204 survey points loaded in the drawing. Export the drawing to DXF format for use in AutoCAD or other CAD software. In TopoCal's Spanish menu interface: look in the 'Archivo' menu (File) for a DXF export option ('Guardar como DXF', 'Exportar DXF', or similar). Save the DXF file to the Desktop with the filename 'denver_survey.dxf'. The exported file should contain the survey points with their coordinates.
